content:
shreya: Customer reports SSE stream resumed with duplicate data after reconnect in Safari + CDN in front. They get partial output, reconnect, then full replay; billing doubled.
customer: "Stream stopped mid-response, browser reconnected and we received ids 1-420 again, then 421-980. We were billed for tokens twice."
mike: Any chance Last-Event-ID is getting removed at the edge on reconnects?
jackie: Captured requests from their site. Reconnect requests to the CDN show no Last-Event-ID header even when client sets it.
samir: Can you paste the minimal repro curl sequence to hit the CDN host?
jackie: Repro:
```
curl -i -N "https://cdn.redwood.example/stream?session=abc" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
# then simulate reconnect which should include Last-Event-ID
curl -i -N "https://cdn.redwood.example/stream?session=abc" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Last-Event-ID: 420" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
jackie: Origin logs show second request arrived without Last-Event-ID.
mike: Common CDN/WAF behavior: unknown headers stripped unless whitelisted; preflight for XHR polyfills can also change headers.
shreya: The customer says this mostly hits when they use the Safari EventSource polyfill. Native EventSource behaves differently.
samir: Polyfills often do XHR/fetch reconnects and trigger CORS preflight. If Access-Control-Allow-Headers doesn't include Last-Event-ID it will be blocked by the browser or dropped by the network.
jackie: Also found variants: some polyfills send 'X-EventSource-Last-Id' instead. Edge whitelist didn't include either.
infra-bot: [edge-log] request_id=zzx77 path=/stream headers_received=[Accept,Authorization,User-Agent] headers_forwarded=[Accept,Authorization]
mike: Infra config note: CDN strips cookies on subrequests and may drop unknown headers on cached revalidation responses (304). That could explain missing header.
shreya: Immediate mitigation idea: accept last event position via query param (e.g. ?last_event_id=420) for this customer to avoid replay while we patch CDN.
customer: We'll implement query param if you can promise a timeline for fix.
jackie: Repro steps I used: 1) Safari with polyfill; 2) set network offline/online to force reconnect; 3) observe origin missing Last-Event-ID and server emits from start.
mike: Plan: add Last-Event-ID and X-EventSource-Last-Id to CDN header whitelist, add those to Access-Control-Expose-Headers and Access-Control-Allow-Headers for SSE endpoints, and set Cache-Control: no-store on /stream paths.
samir: Also add docs to devex about SSE requirements: CORS preflight allow headers, expose headers, CDN whitelists, and cookie handling for polyfills.
infra-bot: [deploy-plan] change=cdn-whitelist add_headers: Last-Event-ID,X-EventSource-Last-Id target=staging
mike: Running staging tests now against Safari polyfill and Chrome polyfill.
infra-bot: [deploy-status] change=cdn-whitelist status=staging-deploy-started
jackie: Staging confirms Last-Event-ID forwarded to origin; reconnects resume without replay.
infra-bot: [deploy-status] change=cdn-whitelist status=prod-rollout
mike: Prod rollout completed. Observed reconnects with Last-Event-ID present, server resumed streams, no duplicate emission.
customer: Confirmed on our side. Token usage looks back to normal. Thank you.
shreya: Billing: opened ticket #BILL-987 for duplicated charge credit. Support please follow up.
mike: Added tests and a rollback plan in case cache rules cause regressions.
samir: Follow-up: create a short KB article and a Redwood Console diagnostic that flags misconfigured CDN headers for SSE routes.
shreya: Action items recap: infra whitelist headers + no-store for /stream; support give customer query-param workaround and timeline; billing ticket created; devex doc + KB article.
customer: Appreciate the fast turnaround.
